config.experiment: 020-attr-foundation (D-018 cycle; docs/08 + docs/09 pre-registration): M0, M1, H-A1, H-A4. All constants frozen before any attribution score was read.
config.feature_layout: 004 secondary = [blk4 CLS|blk4 mean|blk8 CLS|blk8 mean|blk12 CLS|blk12 mean], H=768
config.fs_tiebreak: inner-CV bacc ties -> first in fs_order, then smaller C
config.m1_label_model: logistic (standardised, C by inner grouped CV); HistGradientBoosting = sensitivity only (not used for the label)

fov224.note: resize-based launderings cannot go through the 224 backbone (016 config); only JPEG-only conditions exist. There is no held-out laundering for RAID.

ha1_raid.note: existing 100 RAID ids; gen_k -> generator mapping is [unverified]. The +400 ids arm is added later by pointing universes.fov224.splits at an extended splits file (config only).

ha4.novelty_primary: mahalanobis (class means, shared Ledoit-Wolf covariance of within-class residuals, min over known classes); kNN-10 = reported alternative
ha4.e10_reference: experiments/019-source-diversity/results/tables.md (k=5, F_b8, reading A FPR per held-out source)

labels_text.H-A1: PASS: at jpeg75_resize05 (T-mix, inner-CV nested feature set): bacc >= 0.60 AND bacc CI lower bound >= M1 bacc + 0.10 AND pairwise (macro over generator pairs) >= 0.75 AND RAID 4-way bacc (jpeg(75)) >= 0.55. KILL: bacc < 0.35 or pairwise < 0.60. Else INCONCLUSIVE.
labels_text.open-set usable: mean LOGO AUROC >= 0.80 and no generator < 0.65, for -max softmax OR Mahalanobis (both flags reported)
labels_text.H-A4: PASS: mean novelty AUROC (Mahalanobis, b8, T-mix) >= 0.85 at jpeg75_resize05 and min >= 0.70. KILL: mean < 0.70. Else INCONCLUSIVE.
labels_text.DISCOVERY: kind accuracy >= 0.95 for every held-out REAL source (8), jpeg75_resize05, b8, T-mix

interpretations: pairwise = 2-AFC: for an image pair (a of A, b of B) in one caption family, correct iff s_A(a)-s_B(a) > s_A(b)-s_B(b) (s = class log-probability); ties = 0.5; chance 0.5. The strict 'both' reading is reported too.
pairwise headline = macro over generator pairs; pooled over pairs reported.
RAID primary condition = jpeg(75) (only JPEG-only conditions exist at fov224).
H-A4 novelty primary = Mahalanobis on b8 (fixed a priori, not chosen on test); b4/b12 reported with Holm. Concat omitted for H-A4 (cost).
'CI lower bound >= M1 + 0.10' read literally: lo(bacc_method) >= bacc_M1(point) + 0.10; the paired-difference CI is also reported.

perm_control.note: fixed feature set and C for the 200-shuffle control (no selection): label-permuted nested-free pipeline, T-mix training, primary condition

holm_vs_M1_plus_010.note: p = share of bootstrap diffs (bacc_fs - bacc_M1) <= 0.10; Holm over the 4 feature sets
